status: Declared before new nested outcomes; exploratory procedure diagnostic only, not a replacement of the primary research or final model selection
purpose: Study whether a technical training exceedance screen can be selected inside the training sample rather than chosen ad hoc. Do not change the client service risk benchmark.
history: Development scenarios 1–120 and old V1 final results were already inspected during prior exploratory work. This is prospective specification of a new procedure on reused development data, not preregistration on unseen data or a fresh blind test.

static_family.risk_event: Full client-H real annual MDD > client L + 1e-12, preserving the original annual observation definition

parameter_meaning: gamma is passed to the unchanged fit_menu empirical training screen. It is a technical learning parameter, not a fitted or newly declared client preference; service alpha stays .10. Nested fit outputs rename the legacy alpha argument to solver_gamma/training_screen_gamma and retain service_alpha separately.

inner_validation.construction: Sort context training IDs, permute with numpy.default_rng(seed_base+context_id), split into four equal chunks; each inner train is the sorted complement. Every gamma uses the same declared folds.
inner_validation.fitting: For every gamma and inner fold, refit the whole original common-menu procedure, including feasibility, oracle, menu optimization, extension and assignment, using only inner training indices. Freeze it before evaluating its inner validation paths.
inner_validation.annual_execution: Use the same pre-fixed annual static candidate cache. Precomputed outcomes are safe to reuse; only the nominated inner train indices enter fitting.
inner_validation.nulls: Review remains null financial outcomes and counts in the profile/path coverage denominator; never impute zero risk or adviser returns.

gamma_eligibility.profile_test: For each profile with at least one automatic inner OOF path, conditional breach_count/auto_n <= service_alpha + 1e-12. Profiles with auto_n=0 retain null risk/growth and do not pass as zero-risk observations.
gamma_eligibility.whole_zero_coverage: A gamma with zero automatic paths across all profiles is ineligible, reason=no_inner_auto_outcomes.
gamma_eligibility.meaning: An empirical pointwise heuristic on dependent inner folds and possibly small, selected automatic subgroups. It is not statistical risk certification or guaranteed calibration.

priority: Maximize automatic inner OOF path-profile count
Within exact maximum coverage, maximize mean annualized log growth over automatic path-profile units
Within a single 1e-12 band below that maximum growth, choose the smallest gamma
gamma_selection.representation: The five supplied profiles have equal original path counts. They are representatives, not population frequencies. The conditional auto-unit growth objective weights profiles according to the automatically served path counts; service composition can change across gamma.
gamma_selection.no_eligible: selected_gamma=null and calibration_unsupported; do not force gamma=0 or call a negative/default screen. Preserve all effective assignments as Review and financial outcomes as null.

refit_and_admission.raw_fit: After gamma selection, refit the unchanged fit_menu once using all current context training scenarios at the chosen gamma. Do not choose weights/products based on outer test paths.
refit_and_admission.raw_menu_objective: The original coverage/minimax-regret/mean-regret objective describes the raw fit before admission guard. It is not a globally optimized objective after the guard.
refit_and_admission.guard: Retain the raw menu, raw assignment and raw evidence. If a raw assignment is automatic but that profile had auto_n=0 in the selected gamma inner OOF, effective assignment=Review with reason=no_inner_auto_evidence. Do not refit targets, fill replacement products or silently remove raw evidence.
refit_and_admission.partial_coverage: For inner auto_n>0 retain the stated eligibility rule. Report auto_n and automatic fold count; add no arbitrary minimum n, four-of-four condition or additional tuned threshold.

inner_score_vs_effective_service: Inner gamma scoring evaluates the raw menu/assignment process. Outer and full effective outputs additionally apply the declared admission guard. The inner objective does not directly globally optimize the post-guard effective service; report raw and effective coverage separately.
outer_evaluation: For each original outer fold, calibrate gamma and refit/guard using only its 96 training paths; evaluate the effective assignment on its 24 test paths. Preserve raw outcomes separately for admission diagnostics. Outer test results never change gamma, target or guard.
full_development: Calibrate with 4x90/30 inner folds on all 120, then refit/guard on all120. Report as a training-context descriptive fit, not external validation.
reference: Compare against the already saved primary gamma=.10 risk_only full/fold menus and original 600 OOF client-path rows without changing them.

postfit_static_family_evidence.use: Optional postfit simultaneous upper bound on each fixed annual target/client event; never used in gamma eligibility, selection or admission. Conditional on the existing iid/fixed-family assumptions, selection within the same 232-target static family is permitted. No joint assertion across all training folds, growth guarantee or OOF pooled certificate.

reporting: All inner fold menus/IDs and all gamma path-level OOF results
Per-profile and total inner coverage, risk counts/denominators, automatic fold counts and auto-unit annualized log growth
Eligibility reasons, selection criterion and chosen gamma
Raw/effective full refits, admission changes, postfit raw objective and client-product diagnostics
Effective and raw outer OOF with all referrals retained, compared with unchanged primary gamma=.10
Source/input/output start/end hashes and guarded-development input hash
prohibited: Changing service alpha, gamma candidates, selection criterion or guard after seeing results
Using outer test outcomes in any gamma/menu fit
Bootstrap repetition as model selection or extra independent evidence
Forecasts, dynamic execution rules or liquidity identification
Calling a selected empirical gamma a certified calibrated risk parameter
Replacing the primary research, selecting a final winner or reading final paths121–180
